name: supervision-js-core
description: Platform-neutral detection, timeline, style, and interaction primitives for supervision-js.

scripts.build: npm run build -w supervision-js-trackers && npm run clean && npm run build:types:local && npm run build:js:local
scripts.build:js: npm run build -w supervision-js-trackers && npm run build:js:local
scripts.build:types: npm run build:types -w supervision-js-trackers && npm run build:types:local
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types -w supervision-js-trackers && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
